title: Repository Pattern
description: Abstract data access behind a consistent interface.

data.text: The **Repository Pattern** mediates between the domain and data mapping layers, acting like an in-memory collection of domain objects.

data.title: Repository Pattern
Key Takeaways
points: Decouples business logic from data access
Makes testing easier with mock repositories
Provides a consistent interface for data operations
data.takeaway: Use Repository Pattern to abstract data access and improve testability.
